SELECT n.id, n.title, n.type, n.level, u.nickname AS publisher_name, n.publish_time, un.is_read, un.read_time FROM sys_user_notice un INNER JOIN sys_notice n ON n.id = un.notice_id AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.publish_status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.publisher_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE un.user_id = #{queryParams.userId} AND un.is_deleted = 0
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParams.title}, '%')
AND un.is_read = #{queryParams.isRead}
ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC, n.create_time DESC
